ARIA_PCM_CHANNELS.description: Number of interleaved audio channels in an AriaCast PCM frame.

ARIA_PCM_SAMPLE_BYTES.description: Bytes per channel sample in the AriaCast signed little-endian PCM format.

ARIA_PCM_FRAMES.description: Audio frames carried by one complete AriaCast PCM message.

ARIA_DISCOVERY_PORT.description: UDP port for AriaCast discovery and private diagnostic queries.

ARIA_STREAM_PORT.description: TCP port for AriaCast streaming and listening connections.

ARIA_LISTEN_REQUEST.description: Request text that selects silent listening mode instead of audible network playback.

ARIA_LISTEN_ACK.description: Acknowledgement text confirming that the receiver accepted listening mode.
